name: Pi-hole
description: Pi-hole is a network-wide ad blocker that acts as a DNS sinkhole, protecting your devices from unwanted ads and trackers without installing any client-side software.
longDescription:
Pi-hole is a Linux network-level advertisement and Internet tracker blocking application which acts as a DNS sinkhole and optionally a DHCP server, intended for use on a private network. It is designed for low-power embedded devices with network capability, such as the Raspberry Pi, but can be installed on almost any Linux machine.

Pi-hole blocks ads for all devices on your network without requiring any client-side software. It features a beautiful web-based admin interface for managing and monitoring your DNS queries, blocklists, and whitelists. With Pi-hole, you can also see statistics about the DNS queries on your network, including the number of queries blocked and the domains most frequently accessed.
